name: Shear-Jashub
title: The Prophet's Son with a Symbolic Name
summary: Shear-Jashub was the eldest son of the prophet Isaiah. His name means 'a remnant shall return' and served as a prophetic sign to Judah that a faithful remnant of the people would survive God's judgment and turn back to Him.

keyEvents.title: The Meeting with King Ahaz
keyEvents.description: Shear-Jashub was brought by his father Isaiah to meet King Ahaz at the end of the Upper Pool's aqueduct. His presence and name conveyed a prophetic message to the king.

keyEvents.title: The Name as Prophecy
keyEvents.description: The name Shear-Jashub ('a remnant shall return') served as a living prophetic sign, reminding the people of both judgment and hope—that although judgment would come, a remnant would survive and turn back to God.

keyEvents.title: Isaiah's Children as Signs
keyEvents.description: Along with his brother Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz, Shear-Jashub was one of the prophetic signs God gave Israel through Isaiah's family.
